PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: page fired for alert: prom_alert:HighScrapeFailures (priority: P1)
PagerDuty Bot: Incident ID PD-98123 — paging: Maya (oncall)

Maya (oncall): seeing a spike in prometheus scrape_failures and a companion alert for kafka-log-ingest-lag. dashboards show scrape_count dropping to 0 for metrics-knative cluster. tagging infra.

Ethan: acked on PagerDuty — I'm on it. first check: prometheus targets page in /targets?group=knative

Maya (oncall): thanks. I'm checking the metrics-proxy pool and the metrics-ingest consumers.

Infra Bot: deploys/metrics-proxy/rolling: last rollout 2026-03-14T00:20:13Z (v2.3.7) — no failures in rollout history.

Ethan: curl to one of the scrape endpoints returns 502 from metrics-proxy:
```
$ curl -sv https://metrics-proxy-us-west-2.internal/_status
* Connected to metrics-proxy-us-west-2.internal (10.12.3.9) port 443 (#0)
> GET /_status HTTP/1.1
> Host: metrics-proxy-us-west-2.internal
> User-Agent: curl/7.79.1
> Accept: */*
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: text/plain
< content-length: 21
<
Bad gateway from upstream
```

Jordi: seeing a ton of 502s in the metrics-proxy logs around 02:10 UTC and a backlog forming in log-forwarder-to-kafka. consumer lag for topic redwood.metrics is 123,457 messages.

Maya (oncall): initial hypothesis: metrics-proxy is overloaded or upstream (ingest) is backpressuring and returning 502s, causing prometheus to mark scrapes failed. Could be a throttling loop.

Ethan: reproducing a failed scrape locally — stacktrace shows connection reset when forwarding to ingest-backend. attaching sample log lines:
```
2026-03-14T02:09:52Z metrics-proxy[pid=49]: WARN upstream connection reset to ingest-backend-1: connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T02:10:03Z metrics-proxy[pid=49]: ERROR failed to proxy request: upstream 503
2026-03-14T02:10:07Z log-forwarder[pid=11]: WARN kafka flush timeout, backlog_size=21345
```

Support Ops: any customer-facing alerts yet? Grafana Cloud team asked if this affects metrics retention.

Maya (oncall): no public product outage reported yet. internal dashboards showing delayed/empty panels. Support Ops: please mark impacted customers as dashboards delayed/metrics delayed. I'll draft an incident bridge note.

PagerDuty Bot: Maya (oncall) acknowledged the page at 1769951250.

Ethan: quick mitigation: temporarily reduce scrape concurrency from 20 -> 5 and enable immediate retry with jitter to avoid thundering herd. I'm pushing a config change to staging first. Command:
```
kubectl -n telemetry set env deploy/metrics-proxy SCRAPE_CONCURRENCY=5
kubectl -n telemetry rollout restart deploy/metrics-proxy
```

Maya (oncall): good. if that reduces upstream pressure we can start draining the kafka backlog. also consider turning on metrics-cache layer for high-volume targets.

Jordi: I can scale up the kafka consumers by adding 4 partitions -> consumers will rebalance. planning to bump consumer group replicas from 6 -> 10.

Infra Bot: autoscaler action: scaled statefulset/log-consumers from 6 -> 10 replicas (triggered by manual command).

Ethan: metrics-proxy rollout to telemetry namespace started, pods coming up with SCRAPE_CONCURRENCY=5. early logs show fewer 502s. prometheus scrape success ratio climbing from 42% -> 78% for knative cluster.

Maya (oncall): good. Jordi please monitor consumer lag and SLO for end-to-end ingest latency.

Jordi: consumer lag falling: 123k -> 58k over 6 minutes after new workers came up. retention window still ok.

Support Ops: logged a message to the customer status page: "We are investigating delays in telemetry dashboards due to ingestion backpressure. No service outages. Updates in 15 minutes."

Maya (oncall): prepping handoff notes for next on-call in 20m. Current mitigation: reduced scrape concurrency, added consumers, drained backlog. Remaining work: run root cause (why did ingest-backend start rejecting connections?) and validate replay of missing metrics.

Ethan: quick note — discovered a GC storm on ingest-backend-2 around 02:08 which coincides with upstream resets. I'll open a follow-up ticket for investigation (infra-987).

Lena: jumping on bridge for handoff in 15. thanks team. I'll continue monitoring and will escalate to platform if we see regressions.

Maya (oncall): handing off to Lena. final status at handoff: scrape success ~92% for knative, kafka lag 12k and decreasing, customer impact contained to delayed dashboards.

PagerDuty Bot: PD incident PD-98123 marked as "acknowledged" and assigned to Maya (oncall).

Maya (oncall): incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. next steps: postmortem to include timeline, GC traces from ingest-backend, and suggestion to add circuit-breaker on metrics-proxy to fail fast.

Lena: acked handoff. I'll keep bridge open for 1 hour and then close if stable.

Support Ops: noted for communications: send final update when bridge closes.

Maya (oncall): thanks all :thumbsup: — closing thread once Lena confirms stable.
